{npc:Eclesius}, an absent-minded sorcerer who lives near Thais, is looking for a new assistant. The quest has two parts: five short chores you can repeat every day (sweeping, polishing, feeding the fish, exterminating bats and "preventing the apocalypse") and six missions that take you to Venore, Ab'Dendriel, Kazordoon and Carlin. In total you earn about 5350 gp and 10650 experience points.
Eclesius is looking for a new assistant.
To enter Eclesius' house you have to use a {item:Magic Door} (in his house or in the {wiki:Adventurer's Guild}).
mission 2 (buy in Venore or pick up from the chest next to Sam, in Thais)
mission 3, mugs of beer for Grodrik
approximate total of all tasks and missions
Daily tasks: between 100 and 250 gp and between 150 and 300 experience each, repeatable
The tasks are daily: you can do them all on the same day and repeat them the next day. Most of the ingredients can be found around Thais or bought in Venore.
The items created in the tasks ({item:Fish Flakes}, {item:Special Polish}, {item:Flask with Magical Oil}) disappear when you use them: you have to make them again each day.
In the Exterminate task **never** attack the {creature:Cat|white cat} in the attic: if you kill it, Eclesius won't let you do that task for 30 days.
Before setting off on mission 1, buy the {item:Sandals} in Venore right away (or get them for free from the chest next to {npc:Sam}) for mission 2.
Mission 3 makes you go back and forth several times between Thais, Kazordoon and Ab'Dendriel. Bring all 7 {item:Beer|beers} the first time.
The quest has two parts: 5 short daily tasks and 6 missions. Always start here.
Go to {npc:Eclesius}' house, near Thais. To get in you have to pass the {item:Magic Door}: the one at the house itself or the one in the {wiki:Adventurer's Guild}.

Say {key:hi} to Eclesius and answer {key:yes} when he asks if you want to be the new assistant. You immediately gain 100 experience points. Then say {key:task} to hear the five tasks: {key:sweep}, {key:polish}, {key:feed}, {key:exterminate} and {key:prevent}.

Use the {item:Broom} on **all the pieces of furniture** in the living room, in the room behind the sealed door and in the bedroom. You don't need to sweep the goldfish bowl, the crystal ball or the chimney.
Furniture to sweep in Eclesius' house
Don't use the broom on the {item:Fire Basin}: it burns up and disappears.
Go back to Eclesius and say {key:hi}, {key:task}, {key:sweep} and {key:yes}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:task} and {key:feed} to {npc:Eclesius}. The food recipe is on a piece of paper pinned to the wall above the {item:Goldfish Bowl (Object)|goldfish bowl}.
Get 1 ounce of {item:Flour}, 1 {item:Worm}, 1 {item:White Mushroom}, 1 {item:Egg} and 1 {item:Sling Herb}.
Go down to the laboratory (floor below), put the five ingredients on the {item:Magical Blending Device} and pull the lever right next to it. You receive the {item:Fish Flakes}.
The Magical Blending Device and the lever in the laboratory
Use the {item:Fish Flakes} on the {item:Goldfish Bowl (Object)|goldfish bowl}. The flakes disappear when used, so you have to make them again each day.
Using the Fish Flakes on the goldfish bowl
Go back to Eclesius and say {key:hi}, {key:task}, {key:feed} and {key:yes}. If he asks what the fish said, you can answer {key:blub}.
4. Daily task: Polish (polish the crystal ball)
To reach the laboratory you must also have started the Sweep or the Prevent task, otherwise you can't get through the sealed door. In some worlds the {item:Honeycomb} costs more than the reward.
Bring 1 {item:Honeycomb} and 1 {item:Grave Flower}. Say {key:hi}, {key:task} and {key:polish} to {npc:Eclesius}. He gives you access to the laboratory.
Go down to the laboratory. The recipe is pinned to the wall above the oven.
Use the {item:Honeycomb} on the oven to get {item:Molten Wax}.
Use the {item:Molten Wax} on the {item:Grave Flower} to get the {item:Special Polish}.
Use the {item:Special Polish} on Eclesius' {item:Crystal Ball (Object)|crystal ball}. The polish disappears when used: you have to make it again each day.
Using the Special Polish on the crystal ball
Say {key:hi}, {key:task} and {key:exterminate} to {npc:Eclesius}. He lets you into the attic. Bring a weapon.
Go up to the attic, open the door and kill the **three** {creature:Bat|Bats}.
The attic with the bats and the cat
**DO NOT** kill the {creature:Cat|white cat}. If you kill it, Eclesius won't let you do this task for 30 days.

Eclesius has locked a "demon uberoverlord" in a cage in the cellar. You have to oil the lock, lock the door, reinforce the boards and play music to calm it. In some worlds the {item:Wolf Paw} costs more than the reward.

The ingredient list is on a piece of paper pinned to the wall behind the empty pot, in the laboratory. Get 1 vial of {item:Oil}, 1 {item:Skull (Item)|Skull}, 1 {item:Red Apple} and 1 {item:Wolf Paw}. Also bring a {item:Wooden Hammer} and a {item:Lyre}.
With the ingredients, say {key:hi}, {key:magical oil} and {key:yes} to Eclesius. He keeps the ingredients and gives you a {item:Flask with Magical Oil}.
Ask Eclesius about the key (key of magic): he says it is somewhere in the laboratory. Go down to the laboratory and use the {item:Barrel|barrel} to receive the {item:Magical Key}.
Go down to the cellar and use the {item:Flask with Magical Oil} on the locked cellar door. The oil disappears when used: you have to make it again each day.
Using the magic oil on the cellar door
Lock the cage and nail the boards
Use the {item:Magical Key} on the locked cage door. Then use the {item:Wooden Hammer} on the **four** wooden boards right next to the cage door.
Using the Magical Key on the cage door
The wooden boards to reinforce with the Wooden Hammer
Stand right next to the locked cage door and use the {item:Lyre}.
Playing the lyre next to the cage
7. Mission 1: A Hat for the Sane
Eclesius wants a new hat. Of the three the seamstress can make, the right one is the **Dark Hat**.

Before going to Venore, get 1 {item:Minotaur Leather} and 2 {item:Bat Wing|Bat Wings}. Also take the chance to buy some {item:Sandals} for mission 2 (or get them for free from a quest chest next to {npc:Sam}'s shop, in Thais).

At the Thais harbour, talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} (170 gp). You arrive at the Venore harbour, next to {npc:Captain Fearless}. The Dress for Success warehouse is in the city.
Irmana (upper floor of Dress for Success)

Go to **Venore**, to the Dress for Success warehouse, and go up to the upper floor. Talk to {npc:Irmana}: say {key:hi}, {key:hat}, {key:dark hat} and {key:yes}. She uses the materials and gives you the {item:Hat for Eclesius (Dark)}.
Don't choose the {item:Hat for Eclesius (Pink)|Pink Hat} or the {item:Hat for Eclesius (Wooden)|Wooden Hat}: Eclesius wants a "manly", "not pink" and "not too heavy" hat.
Leave the warehouse and go back to the Venore harbour. Say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} to {npc:Captain Fearless} to return to Thais and from there walk to Eclesius' house.
Go back to Eclesius and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Eclesius' sandals smell really bad. You are going to get him a new pair with an "anti-smelly-feet-hex".

Get a pair of {item:Sandals} (bought in Venore or from the quest chest next to {npc:Sam}, in Thais). Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to Eclesius. He writes his name on them and gives them back to you.
Don't lose the marked sandals: if you lose them you have to start everything again.
Go down to the laboratory and use the sandals on the big cauldron. Then go back to Eclesius and say {key:mission}.
Use the sandals on a dead skunk
Kill a {creature:Skunk} (there are some wandering just east of Eclesius' house) and use the sandals on the fresh corpse. Go back to Eclesius and say {key:mission}.
Eclesius asks what smells nice. Say {key:blueberry} (the easiest), {key:bread} or {key:flower}. There is a {item:Blueberry|blueberry} bush right at his front door.
Blueberry bush next to the house
A *white flower* (not to be confused with the dew kisser flowers near the house)
Use the sandals on the chosen object (for example, the blueberry bush). Go back to Eclesius and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Eclesius wants to create a new race by crossing elves and dwarves. You will act as a "dating agent". This mission has many trips between Thais, Kazordoon and Ab'Dendriel.
Trips between Thais, Ab'Dendriel and Kazordoon

**Thais ↔ Ab'Dendriel**: at the Thais harbour, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes} (130 gp); to come back, {npc:Captain Seagull} in Ab'Dendriel: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (130 gp).
**Kazordoon** is inside the mountain The Big Old One, in the middle of the continent, and has no regular boat. Go **on foot**: from Thais through the {wiki:Mount Sternum} passage (see maps), or from anywhere through the main entrance of the mountain (bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}: there are rope spots and hidden holes). Alternatively, take the {wiki:Steamship} in {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Gurbasch}) or in Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}) with {key:kazordoon}. To leave, take the same way on foot in reverse, or use {npc:Brodrosch}'s steamship at the bottom of the city ({key:cormaya} or {key:farmine}).
Way from Thais to Kazordoon via Mount Sternum (1)
Way from Thais to Kazordoon via Mount Sternum (2)

Go to **Ab'Dendriel** and go up to the second floor of the library. Talk to {npc:Amarie} using exactly this sequence: {key:hi}, {key:study}, {key:yes}, {key:milkbugs}, {key:care}, {key:dream}, {key:book}, {key:poetry}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}, {key:love}, {key:dating}, {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Amarie's Favourite Book}.

Buy **at least 7** {item:Beer|mugs of beer} and go to the tavern in **Kazordoon**. Talk to {npc:Grodrik} using exactly this sequence: {key:hi}, {key:problems}, {key:yes}, {key:woman}, {key:beer}, {key:woman}, {key:beer}, {key:woman}, {key:beer}, {key:wishes}, {key:lonely}, {key:beer}, {key:lonely}, {key:wishes}, {key:beer}, {key:wishes}, {key:woman}, {key:beer}, {key:dating}, {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Grodrik's Favourite Axe}.
Go back to Eclesius and say {key:mission}, {key:yes} and then {key:no} (when he asks whether the two would get along well). He sends you to fetch a scroll with questions from the library.
Go up to Eclesius' library (upper floor) and take the scroll from the drawer. It has 8 questions, which **change from player to player**.
Go back to Ab'Dendriel. Say {key:hi}, {key:yes} to {npc:Amarie} and then type the 8 questions from your scroll, one by one. Take note of the answers.
A green meadow in the middle of a forest
The questions are different for each player; the table is only an example.
Go to Kazordoon. Say {key:hi}, {key:yes} to {npc:Grodrik} and type the same 8 questions. Compare the answers with Amarie's and find what they have in common.
A long, combed beard, small toes
In the example, the similarity is that they both like chocolate.
Go back to Eclesius and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:no} (you are not here about the milk delivery), {key:yes} and then the similarity you found (in the example: {key:they like chocolate}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes} again. Eclesius gives you two doses of {item:Love Potion}.
Don't use force to convince the two. They must not know it is a love potion.
Go to Ab'Dendriel. Say {key:hi}, {key:drink}, {key:milkbug} and {key:yes} to {npc:Amarie}: she thinks it is bug milk and drinks it.
Go to Kazordoon. Say {key:hi}, {key:beer} and {key:yes} to {npc:Grodrik}: he drinks the potion thinking it is beer.
Go to the void in space-time

Go back to Eclesius and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes} again: he takes you to a {wiki:Void} in the space-time continuum under the house (similar to the {wiki:Dream Realm}).
In the void, say {key:hi} and {key:yes} to Eclesius. He explains the three levers.

Pull the levers in this order: 1) **left** ({creature:Amarie (Creature)|Amarie} appears), 2) **right** ({creature:Grodrik (Creature)|Grodrik} appears), 3) **middle** (mixes the two). The machine malfunctions and instead of a "Dwelf" a {creature:Gozzler}, a {creature:Mutated Human} or a {creature:Toad} appears.
Say {key:hi}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} to Eclesius to go back home. There, say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to receive the reward.
A riddle: you have to say the colour of each book scattered around Eclesius' library.

Say {key:mission} to {npc:Eclesius}. He explains the riddle: you have to tell him the colour of each book in the library. If you want hints, ask him for them (there are six hints, given at random; he may repeat himself). The possible colours are red, brown, light blue, dark blue, light green and dark green.
The book in the middle of the room is about counterspells.
The book about conversions is not blue.
The Great Encyclopedia is not a large book, nor is it green.
The book next to the broken bottle was not written by a professor.
The light green book was written by a woman.
The book about the growth of grass is not the colour you would expect.
Say {key:mission} again and answer the six questions in the order he asks them. At the end say {key:yes}. If you get it wrong, you can try again right away.
Eclesius invented the formula for a memory potion while drinking in Thais, but he forgot it and who he talked to. It was {npc:Xodet}.
If you want to follow the lead, say {key:hi}, {key:eclesius}, {key:last night} and {key:talked} to {npc:Frodo}, in the Thais tavern. He doesn't know exactly who Eclesius talked to.

Go to {npc:Xodet}'s magic shop, in Thais, and say: {key:hi}, {key:eclesius}, {key:potion}, {key:formula}, {key:eclesius}, {key:chit chat}, {key:magician}, {key:eclesius}. He gets angry and refuses to help.
Go back to Eclesius and say {key:mission}, {key:xodet} and {key:yes}. He asks you to find Xodet's first wand.

The {item:Xodet's First Wand} is in the cellar of Xodet's shop. Enter through the southeast sewers of Thais and follow them to the cellar. To leave, go back through the sewers the same way to the southeast entrance and return to the surface of Thais.
Southeast sewer entrance (access to Xodet's cellar)
Say {key:hi} and {key:your first wand} to {npc:Xodet}. He repents and gives you the paper with the formula.
Go back to Eclesius and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
The frog in the cellar ({npc:A Confused Frog}) is Eclesius' former assistant. You are going to try to return him to human form.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Eclesius}. He wants you to get princess clothes from {npc:Queen Eloise}, in Carlin.
At the Thais harbour, talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes} (110 gp). You arrive at the Carlin harbour, next to {npc:Captain Greyhound}; the castle is in the city.
Go to the **Carlin** castle. Greet {npc:Queen Eloise} with {key:hail queen} (not hi) and say {key:dress}. She sends you to talk to the general.
Ask the general for the rags
Go up two floors in the castle and talk to {npc:Bunny Bonecrusher}: {key:hail general}, {key:dress}, {key:yes}, {key:old rag}. You receive a {item:Bundle of Rags}.
Leave the castle and go back to the Carlin harbour. Say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (110 gp) to {npc:Captain Greyhound} and walk back to Eclesius' house.
Go back to Eclesius and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Go down to the cellar. Use the {item:Bundle of Rags} to put on a blank Noblewoman Outfit for 3 minutes. Then talk to {npc:A Confused Frog}: {key:ribbit}, {key:kiss}, {key:kiss}. It doesn't work.
You only have 3 minutes of disguise: use the rags right next to the frog.
Plan B: ask for the ingredient list

Go back to Eclesius and say {key:mission}, {key:no}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He asks you for all of these at the same time: {item:Silver Amulet}, {item:Dagger}, {item:Green Tapestry}, {item:Blank Rune} and {item:Dirty Fur}.
With the five items in your inventory, say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to Eclesius.
Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes} again. Eclesius teaches you the spell: *Eeny, meeny, miny, moe - ribbit, ribbit head to toe!*
Recite the spell to the frog

Go down to the cellar and say to {npc:A Confused Frog}: {key:hi} and then {key:Eeny, meeny, miny, moe - ribbit, ribbit head to toe!}. The frog speaks again, but does not become human again. Ask him what he wants: say {key:human} (or {key:frog} and then {key:lake}). He prefers to stay a frog and live by a lake north of Thais.
Go back to Eclesius and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He gives you the second spell: *Eeny, meeny, miny, moe - I stay here and you will go!*
Swap with a frog from the lake

Go to {wiki:Alatar Lake}, north of Thais, and look for {npc:A Frog}. Say {key:ribbit} and then {key:Eeny, meeny, miny, moe - I stay here and you will go!}. To return, walk back **south**, the same way, to Eclesius' house.
Go back to Eclesius and say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to receive the final reward.
After finishing the missions, you can still do the five daily tasks to earn gp and experience.
In mission 3, the scroll questions (and therefore the similarities between Amarie and Grodrik) change from player to player.
In mission 2, the sandals are needed right at the start: there is a quest chest with free {item:Sandals} next to {npc:Sam}, in Thais.
